text: Unified sync and async codec interpretation around immutable CodecProgram values and explicit runtimes. Readers, JVM writer, NeuroArchive, and dataset integrations now share the same execution semantics; bytes and CRC32C remain dependency-free core capabilities and gzip is platform-injected. Focused gates passed warning-clean: zarr JVM 74, zarr JS 73, archive-zarr JVM 11, archive-zarr JS 8, dataset-zarr JVM 7, dataset-zarr JS 3; existing Zarr-Python binary fixtures remain exact.
